Hulking Metamorph  is a copy of Myr Galvanizer.

description:
Activate either Myr Galvanizer or Hulking Metamorph by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping each other Myr you control.
Activate Palladium Myr by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
